meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读入并组织单细胞测序产生的注释矩阵,为下游分析打好基础。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理单细胞测序结果,需要按注释矩阵整理基因表达数据。
copy.tagline_en: Read and organize annotated single-cell matrices for downstream analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you handle single-cell sequencing data and need a standard way to organize annotated expression matrices.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能创建、读写 .h5ad 和 zarr 等注释矩阵文件,按条件筛选、取子集、合并多个数据集,并把数据接入 scanpy 等 scverse 工具。
howto.when: 当你处理 .h5ad、zarr 等文件,或在 scanpy、scvi-tools 等 scverse 生态里做单细胞分析、合并批次时触发。

say.text: 读取这个 data.h5ad,告诉我它有多少细胞和基因
say.note: 返回 n_obs × n_vars 等维度信息

say.text: 把 batch1.h5ad 和 batch2.h5ad 按批次标签合并成一个对象
say.note: 用 ad.concat 加 label/keys 完成合并

say.text: 用 backed='r' 打开这个 100GB 的 h5ad,再按质量分筛子集
say.note: 懒加载后只把子集读进内存

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can create, read, and write .h5ad and zarr annotated matrices, subset, filter, and concatenate datasets, and plug them into scanpy and other scverse tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work with .h5ad or zarr files, or do single-cell analysis and batch merging in the scverse ecosystem such as scanpy or scvi-tools.

Concatenate batch1.h5ad and batch2.h5ad with per-batch labels
say_en.note: Uses ad.concat with label and keys

say_en.text: Open this 100GB h5ad with backed='r' and filter by quality score
